entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: [fName]-senpai, did you see[n]that? Their dance was amazing.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I wish I could be like that...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Sorry if I'm getting a little carried away.[n]I don't get to go to places like this[n]much...
entries.uk: Вибач, якщо я трохи захопилася.[n]Я нечасто буваю[n]в таких місцях...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Well, now that the parade's over...[n]what should we do?
Could see an attraction.
Let's look around.[clr 27]
Let's get some food.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh! I've been really curious about the[n]ones we passed walking around!
entries.uk: О! Мені страшенно цікаві ті,[n]повз які ми проходили!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: There were so many... I wonder which[n]one we should go to.
entries.uk: Їх було стільки... Цікаво,[n]на який нам піти.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, let's! It's such a wonderful place[n]to be!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And if I'm with you, Senpai, it'll be[n]so much more fun!
entries.uk: А з тобою, семпаю, буде[n]ще веселіше!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, good idea! I've already seen a few[n]things I need to try...
entries.uk: О, гарна ідея! Я вже приглянула[n]кілька речей, які треба скуштувати...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh! Senpai, maybe you'd like to share[n]something with me?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: *giggle* I'm so excited... Let's get[n]going, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: How'd it get so late...? Time went by[n]so fast...
entries.uk: Коли це встигло так пізно стати...?[n]Час так швидко минув...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: U-Um, can we stay a little longer?[n]I kind of want to see the night[n]parade, too...
entries.uk: Е-е, можна ми ще трохи побудемо?[n]Мені ще хочеться подивитися[n]нічний парад...

entries.en: I want to stay with you, too.[clr 27]
entries.uk: Я теж хочу бути з тобою.[clr 27]

entries.en: Fine by me.
We'll enjoy this to the end.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wh...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I, um... Me too...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You're right. Until the end... We'll[n]stay together forever.
entries.uk: Твоя правда. До кінця... Ми[n]завжди будемо разом.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And, um... I actually have a request.
entries.uk: І, е-е... в мене, власне, є прохання.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It's so cold... We should hold hands.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Eheh... We're warming up fast, huh...?
